newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 178,800 running bales (RB) were seven percent below the previous week and 21 percent less than the four-week average.
The major increases were for China (54,400 RB), Mexico (52,100 RB), Brazil (22,400 RB), Ireland (15,000 RB), and South Korea (9,900 RB).
Sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year of 31,800 RB were mainly for Mexico (17,300 RB) and South Korea (6,400 RB).

Exports of 145,300 RB were off three percent from the previous week and nine percent from the four-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 68 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere 24 percent, and West European eight percent.
